{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yang Metal Dog''' (庚戌, ''kanoe inu''; onyomi ''kōjutsu'') is the 47th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 47th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Earth Rooster|ja|己酉}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Metal Pig|ja|辛亥}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''庚'' is Yang Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''戌'' (Dog) is Yang Earth; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Metal Dog (庚戌)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): gēngxū
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gaang1 seot1
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kanoe-inu
*** On'yomi: kōjutsu
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gyeongsul (경술)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Canh Tuất

==Months of Yang Metal Dog==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 2 or 7 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Mizunoe (壬)|ja|壬|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jin}} or {{ill|Hinoto (丁)|ja|丁|lt=Hinoto (丁)|2=ja|3=丁|4=zh|5=丁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tei}}), the month of {{ill|September|en|September|qid=Q123|lt=September}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}} of {{ill|Yang Metal Dog|ja|庚戌|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou-Inu|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the seasonal month (from {{ill|Hanlu|en|Hanlu|qid=Q1193124|lt=Cold Dew}} until the day before {{ill|Lidong|en|Lidong|qid=Q1191018|lt=Beginning of Winter}}) as applicable.
